free_tier.stated: Subscription: Starter 500 GB, Essentials 2 TB, Professional 3 TB, Advanced 6 TB. Lifetime via StackSocial: 2 TB $149.97, 3 TB $199.97, 10 TB $359.97. Direct partner landing shows 10 TB lifetime at $249 promo against a $360 base.

egress.terms: Subscription page lists 'Unlimited Bandwidth' as a feature of every paid tier. No metered-egress clause found on the pricing page.

record.interface_detail: Native rclone Tier 1 backend (rclone/rclone backend/drime, integration_tests: Passing, data_integrity: High), plus REST API + webhooks and a documented developer portal
record.tooling: rclone native, first-class; API token auth
record.chaining: best-in-lane chaining among the lifetime vendors: real API, real backend, so it can sit under AList/OpenList

limits.value: Review. Shortest track record of any vendor here.

record.limits_note: Lifetime tiers cap members/workspaces (100 on Advanced 6 TB) but not file size
record.reliability_note: Founded 2024 per third-party review. Shortest track record of any vendor here. No data-loss event yet, simply because there is not enough history. Redemption deadline: code must be redeemed within 30 days of purchase.

evidence.proved: 'Essentials ... EUR 5.50 EUR 4.40 per month, billed annually ... 2 TB of storage'; 'Advanced EUR 19.99 EUR 15.99 per month ... 6 TB'
backend: drime, tier: Tier 1, integration_tests: Passing
